decision: read PDF and DOCX with no library, using the runtime's DecompressionStream
why: works in Workers and Bun; nothing new to vet or ship
evidence: documents.ts; local Worker stage1-check: a deflated PDF read in the Worker

decision: one prose record per PDF page (kb:<path>#p<n>, labelled "<file>, page n")
why: a quote is anchored to its page

decision: what cannot be read reliably is listed, never guessed: encrypted, unknown filters, unreadable font encodings
why: a garbled page must not become evidence
evidence: documents.test.ts: says what it could not read

decision: inflated parts capped at 4 MB; declared zip sizes above the cap refused
why: a small upload cannot expand into a large one
evidence: documents.test.ts: zip bomb, PDF stream past the cap

decision: a declared /Length is trusted only when whitespace follows it before endstream
why: wrong lengths occur in real files and must not cut text

decision: extracted text is untrusted prose; facts need an exact quote, and with no extractor label none are made
why: embedded instructions in a document change nothing
evidence: documents.test.ts: injection page yields no facts

decision: P1.1 flipped; full suite, demo-check, parity, Stage 1 with a PDF on a local Worker
